notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Arashin Sovereign.
description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
When Arashin Sovereign enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
